ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: The figure below is a “chart of changes in the proportion of each age group in China’s total population from four population censuses.” Read the figure and answer: From 1964 to 2000, which age group had the largest population growth in China? <image1>
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure divides the population into three age groups: 0–14, 15–64, and ≥65. Four concentric arcs respectively represent 1964, 1982, 1990, and 2000. Reading the figure, it can be seen that the proportions of each age group in 1964 were approximately: 0–14 years old 40.7%, 15–64 years old 55.7%, and ≥65 years old 3.6%; the proportions of each age group in 2000 were approximately: 0–14 years old 22.9%, 15–64 years old 70.1%, and ≥65 years old 7.0%. Then reason: The question asks about the age group with the largest population growth “quantity” from 1964 to 2000. Population quantity = total population × the proportion of that age group. From 1964 to 2000, China’s total population increased significantly, and the proportion of the 15–64 population was originally the largest and rose from 55.7% to 70.1%, so its absolute population increase was the largest.

raw_record.question_text:
The figure below is a “chart of changes in the proportion of each age group in China’s total population from four population censuses.” Read the figure and answer: From 1964 to 2000, which age group had the largest population growth in China?

<image1>

method.method_draft: 先读图像：图中按年龄段分为0～14岁、15～64岁、≥65岁三部分，四条同心弧对应1964、1982、1990、2000年。读取1964与2000年的比重：0～14岁约由40.7%降到22.9%，15～64岁约由55.7%升到70.1%，≥65岁约由3.6%升到7.0%。再读题干：问题要求比较1964～2000年“人口增长数量”最多的年龄段。桥接规则：某年龄段人口数量=总人口×该年龄段比重；结合1964到2000年中国总人口明显增加，且15～64岁本身占比最大并继续上升，因此其绝对人口增加量最大，答案为15～64岁年龄段。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中把人口分为0～14岁、15～64岁、≥65岁三个年龄段，四条同心弧分别表示1964、1982、1990、2000年。读图可见，1964年各年龄段比重约为：0～14岁40.7%，15～64岁55.7%，≥65岁3.6%；2000年各年龄段比重约为：0～14岁22.9%，15～64岁70.1%，≥65岁7.0%。再推理：题目问的是1964～2000年人口增长“数量”最多的年龄段，人口数量=总人口×该年龄段比重。1964到2000年我国总人口明显增加，而15～64岁人口比重本来最大，并且从55.7%上升到70.1%，所以其绝对人口增加量最大。
